title: Daily routine and healthy living
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a napirendedről, az étkezési szokásaidról és az egészséges életmódról kérdez. Válaszolj több mondatban, és mondj konkrét példákat.

questions.q: What time do you usually get up on a school day? What do you do before school?
What does your typical afternoon look like after school?
Do you think you have enough free time? Why or why not?
What do you usually have for breakfast?
What is your favourite meal? Who cooks it?
Do you eat at the school canteen? What do you think of the food there?
How often do you do sport or exercise?
How many hours do you usually sleep at night?
What do you do when you have a cold?
What could you change to live a healthier life?

usefulPhrases.en: On weekdays I get up at half past six.
I try to eat a lot of fruit and vegetables.
usefulPhrases.hu: Igyekszem sok gyümölcsöt és zöldséget enni.

usefulPhrases.en: I go to the gym twice a week.
When I have a cold, I drink a lot of tea.
I should eat less junk food.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What time do you usually get up on a school day? What do you do before school?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I usually get up at half past six, because my first lesson starts at eight and I go by bus. Before school I have a quick shower, get dressed and pack my bag. To be honest, I'm always in a hurry in the morning.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What do you usually have for breakfast?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: On weekdays I usually have a cheese sandwich and a cup of tea. At the weekend my dad sometimes makes scrambled eggs for the whole family.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Well, it's not too bad, but I should eat more fruit instead of white bread.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you eat at the school canteen? What do you think of the food there?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, almost every day. The soups are quite good, but the main courses are sometimes too greasy, so I don't always finish them.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How often do you do sport or exercise?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I play basketball in the school team twice a week. I think exercise helps me relax after a long day of lessons.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What could you change to live a healthier life?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Actually, I should go to bed earlier. I often stay up until midnight chatting with my friends, and then I feel tired the next day.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó minden kérdésre több mondatban válaszol, és mindig hozzátesz egy okot vagy példát (because my first lesson starts at eight; so I don't always finish them), így a beszélgetés magától halad.
Szókincs: a napirend és az egészséges életmód szavai (get dressed, scrambled eggs, greasy, stay up) pontosak és változatosak, a vizsgázó nem ismétli folyton ugyanazokat a szavakat.

Nyelvhelyesség: a szokásokat következetesen jelen egyszerű idő és gyakoriságot jelző határozók fejezik ki (usually, almost every day, twice a week), a változtatási szándékot pedig a helyes „I should + igető” szerkezet.
Érdemes megtanulni: „To be honest, I'm always in a hurry in the morning.”, „it's not too bad, but …”, „I often stay up until midnight”, „it helps me relax”.
